name: Ecotrust 2011 Central Coast rockfish/lingcod CPFV reported ground value

producer.name: Ecotrust, distributed through California Department of Fish and Wildlife BIOS

units.interview_reported_relative_rockfish_lin: relative weighted value; not trips or catch per unit effort

temporal.update_cadence: Historical one-time interview study; no current update claimed.

provenance.access_service: CDFW BIOS public metadata for DS1091; downloadable archive not verified

evidence.supports: Metadata identifies Ecotrust's spring 2012 captain interviews, 2011 rockfish/lingcod CPFV ground values, source methods, geographic extent and the contact-for-use limitation.

limitations: The source is interviews and relative economic value, not AIS vessel history or exact charter dwell points.
Captains described grounds at varying precision; the combined raster was smoothed for confidentiality. The catalog envelope is not a verified fishing footprint.
The observations concern 2011 and cannot establish current species presence, successful catches or legal access.
Metadata states 'Contact Ecotrust about using this data.' Rights and redistribution are unresolved; no raster or derived geometry may be publicly ingested or published yet.
The linked ZIP and its native grid, nodata mask and cell resolution have not been inspected; source access remains partial.
